composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component pc-contrast-02. Raw slots is a list of length 0..4 inclusive with all items exact integers 2..6 inclusive; empty list is valid. Missing and null are distinct: membership guard checks 'slots' in inputs before reading the value, so absent yields ok:false/slots:null while explicit null yields ok:false/slots:null too (both invalid since null is not an int in 2..6). No bool/float/coercion/exceptions. No I/O, imports or host calls. Module-level result assignment on every path. No execution, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation.
